title: Better Live Coding presentation
description: Chapters, semantic steps and edit operations for a Better Live Coding presentation. Every Enter runs one step.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema.

title.description: Presentation title shown in the preview panel.

chapters.description: Chapters (stages) of the presentation, in teaching order.

relativePath.description: Workspace-relative path using forward slashes. Absolute paths and '..' segments are rejected.

id.description: Identifier made of letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Must be unique.

enumDescriptions: Fast typing (default 12–25 ms/char): state, types, HTML, CSS, simple UI.
Slow typing (default 35–60 ms/char): imports, complete functions, endpoints, core logic.
Choose automatically: imports, functions and endpoints are slow, everything else is fast.

workspace.description: Where the presentation runs and where its start and end states live.

workingDirectory.description: Directory (relative to the workspace folder) in which files are edited live. Default '.'.

initialDirectory.description: Optional pristine copy of the starting files. When omitted, .better-live-coding/checkpoints/initial.json is used.

finalDirectory.description: Optional directory with the expected final files; Validate Presentation compares the last checkpoint with it.

files.description: Additional declared files (relative to the working directory) to checkpoint even if no step edits them.

newFileEol.description: Line ending of files created by createFile. Default 'lf'.

humanMode.description: Deterministic Human Mode. Timing values live in VS Code settings (betterLiveCoding.*).

enabled.description: Set false to always type at the fixed speed. Default true.

seed.description: Seed for the deterministic rhythm. Same seed = same rhythm in every rehearsal.

steps.description: Semantic steps. Each Enter runs exactly one step.

step.description: One meaningful development unit (a state group, a UI block, a function, an endpoint…). All operations run as one checkpoint transaction.

title.description: Step title shown in the status bar and preview.

thinking.description: Text shown as 'Thinking · …' before typing. Defaults to the title.

operations.description: Edit operations, executed in order. They may switch between files freely.

anchor.description: Locates the edit. Text and regex anchors must match exactly once; otherwise the step stops without writing.

text.description: Literal text that occurs exactly once (on 'line' when given).

regex.description: Regular expression that matches exactly once.

flags.description: Regex flags: i, m, s, u.

line.description: 1-based line. Alone it is a position; with text/regex it restricts the search to this line.

endLine.description: 1-based end line of a line/column range.

endColumn.description: 1-based end column of a line/column range.

text.description: Text to type. Use a string, or an array of lines joined with newlines (LF; CRLF documents get CRLF).

effects.description: Native VS Code hints shown while typing. Completions are only displayed, never accepted.

auto.description: Show IntelliSense after 'identifier.' and parameter hints after 'identifier('. Default true.

suggestAfter.description: Show IntelliSense briefly after typing any of these substrings, e.g. 'request.' or 'Resp'.

parameterHintsAfter.description: Show parameter hints after typing any of these substrings, e.g. 'handleUpload('.

type.description: What the operation does. Text edits are typed character by character; only replaceFile is instant.
enumDescriptions: Type text immediately before the anchor.
Type text immediately after the anchor.
Select the anchor, remove it and type the replacement.
Select the anchor and remove it.
Create a new empty file and type its text.
Move the cursor to the anchor (start, or end with cursor: 'end').
Open the file (and optionally reveal an anchor).
Replace the whole file instantly. Only allowed with transient: true (restore/skip helpers), never for normal animation.

label.description: Short description used in the status bar and errors.

expectBefore.description: Text that must exist in the file before this operation.

expectAfter.description: Text that must exist in the file after this operation.

thinking.description: Status-bar thought shown before this operation types.

scroll.description: How the editor scrolls to the edit. Default centerIfOutside.

cursor.description: moveCursor target within the anchor. Default start.

transient.description: Declares an instant, non-animated change. Required for replaceFile.
